goal: Reduce static non-GUI Linux release binary sizes by eliminating unused standard library components.
Shrinks release tools like bitcoind and bitcoin-cli by roughly half a megabyte.
reviewability: Reviewers can help by verifying Guix build output hashes for the latest commit.
agreement: Approach ACK because the cross-compiler package is reused in the GUI stage rather than rebuilt (hebasto)
Open suggestion to check for side effects of Boost wchar macros on Boost.MultiIndex (hebasto)
Guix build hashes verified on earlier commits (willcl-ark, rustaceanrob)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because binary size reduction is modest and it does not fix build breakages or release integrity.
Saves roughly 0.48 MB across static non-GUI Linux binaries by trimming unused standard library code.
